author: No-Angle-982
body:
Gus's World Famous Fried Chicken, Santa Ana, an outpost of a very small chain that began near Memphis, Tennessee.

Freshly fried to order, it's the best fried chicken I've found in OC. Really good sides like fried green tomatoes, fried okra, delicious baked beans. Southern-style pies (chess, sweet potato, etc.). Friendly sit-down service.
